newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy MTBE for September 6-20.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy MTBE for September 6-20.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 3,500 to 7,000-tonnes of September methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE), a company official said on Thursday.
CPC requires the gasoline octane enhancer to be delivered September 6-20 on a cost-and-freight (c+f) basis to Kaohsiung or Keelung.
The tender closes July 29 and is valid for two days.
CPC last purchased by tender two cargoes of 3,500 tonnes of MTBE for August 6-20 at $270 per tonne c+f, taking one cargo each from a Mideast and a European producer.
